name: Polyquart pro a
description: Polyquart Pro A (CAS 880345-00-6 ) is a cationic polymeric conditioning agent used across personal care and cleaning formulations. It functions as both a rheology modifier and surface modifier. This versatile ingredient allows formulators to adjust texture while improving substrate deposition and wetting in a single step. In hair care, it deposits onto negatively charged hair fibers to deliver conditioning. It provides excellent detangling performance in shampoos, conditioners, and leave-in treatments. Skin care formulators incorporate it into lotions and cleansers where controlled viscosity and a smooth after-feel are required. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it modifies surface wetting behavior to improve soil release and substrate coverage. It is also used in fabric care formulations where uniform polymer deposition occurs. This deposition across fiber surfaces affects softness and finish quality in various textile applications. Polyquart Pro A is supplied as an aqueous solution for easy incorporation into water-based systems. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades suited to personal care and industrial cleaning applications. Standard packaging includes drums and intermediate bulk containers for diverse logistics needs. Supply quantities are appropriate for both development-scale and commercial production volumes.
